description: This Java class 'UtilityPaymentService' is a service component in a Spring-based application. It handles utility payment processing, including creating and saving payment entities, interacting with a REST client for external payment processing, and converting data between entities and DTOs. It provides methods for processing payments and retrieving payment records with pagination.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for processing utility payments and retrieving payment history.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment request by saving a payment entity, invoking an external REST client for payment execution, updating the payment status, and returning a response DTO.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of utility payments, converting entities to DTOs.
